newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded but quoted higher on gasoline.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded but quoted higher on gasoline.

text.p: September Brent futures were untraded around midday on Monday but were quoted higher as NYMEX extended its Friday rally.
Brent for September was quoted at $18.53/$18.70 per barrel, up from the London settlement of $18.53 after a gain of nine cents.
NYMEX September crude rose 12 cents to $19.89 in New York, boosted by a tightening gasoline market.
The buying spilled over into ACCESS trading on Monday and boosted September a further nine cents to $19.98 -- the intraday high. However, volume was a small 126 lots.
Gasoline fuelled the firmer tone on the crude markets Friday.
The August contract rose 1.82 cent to 64.03 cent per gallon in New York. On ACCESS, the contract was last traded at 64.20, a rise of 0.17 cent.

Gasoline is partly being pushed higher by tight supplies of MTBE, a blending component for gasoline. In addition, U.S. data has been showing strong implied demand for some weeks, which has tightened the market.
